title: High Wind Risk for Cycling
advice: Advise against cycling under the observed wind conditions. Explain that strong winds can affect balance and vehicle control. Suggest postponing the ride or choosing an alternative mode of transport.

title: High UV During Outdoor Exercise
advice: Advise against unprotected outdoor exercise during the affected period. Recommend rescheduling to early morning or evening and using sun protection.

title: Extreme Apparent Temperature During Exercise
advice: Advise postponing strenuous outdoor exercise. Recommend moving the activity to a cooler period or an indoor location.

title: High Rain Probability During Outdoor Exercise

title: Picnic Suitability Assessment
advice: For picnic-related questions, provide a balanced suitability assessment using the available weather information, including precipitation probability, temperature, apparent temperature, wind, and weather conditions during the requested period. Do not give an unconditional safe or unsafe verdict. Explain any relevant concerns and state when forecast information is unavailable.
reason: Picnic suitability is a qualitative decision involving multiple weather factors rather than one numerical threshold.
